verdict.rationale: Google Voice's first-party docs describe auto attendants that let admins 'design a menu system to direct callers to people or departments', including multi-level auto attendants. Callers can be routed to ring groups so a team answers a shared number with round-robin distribution, and greetings can be set with text-to-speech or uploaded audio. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of per-keypress option mapping (e.g. 'press 1'), independent or hands-on corroboration of the menu routing.
